review.verdict: No formatter correctness issue found in read-only review; 764 scalar recipe cases passed.
review.endian: Source words use low-byte-first node layout. The final 128-bit byte reversal presents chronological bytes MSB-first to SHA256. be64(bit_length) and reverse_bytes(CV) preserve the interfaces.
review.padding: Last block index floor((L+8)/64); delimiter at byte L; big-endian 64-bit L*8 at final bytes 56..63. Handles L mod64 55,56,63,0 and actual 54/55/86/102/118/128/2166/2214 byte frames.
review.windows: BRIDGE_SIX is 6 address bytes + 10 payload bytes; BRIDGE_SEVEN is 7 + 9. SHIFT_TWO and SHIFT_ONE then select consecutive bytes at 2-byte and 1-byte offsets across three 64-bit words.
review.lists: SLH pos5 is address bridge, pos>=6 pair index pos-6 and relative source word1. LMS pos1 is address bridge, pos>=2 pair index floor((pos-2)/2), relative source word1 on even beats and3 on odd beats.
review.prefetch: SELECT/SEND acceptance prepare registered controls and executor list address on same edge; following BUILD samples asynchronous RAM. SEND cannot modify block_buffer until previous compression accepts it.
review.scope: Recipe tests exercise scalar request path, independent hashlib output, capture, hash/compression counts, reset replay, response stalls and disabled-shape rejection. They do not establish complete-core cycle/area benefit or batch scheduling correctness; those are root/other-agent checks.
review.warnings: All observed Verilator warnings come from tb_recipe width conversions; no sha2-recipe/sha256 RTL warning in these three compile logs.
